name: swoosh-text
title: Swoosh Text
description: Extruded letters lit by a moving light: the 3D extrusion swings and overshoots as a cursor sweeps past, then a letter is pressed down like a keycap.
useWhen: A headline should feel like solid, tactile lettering that reacts to a light or a touch.
A short product word or key phrase needs a playful, physical beat.
avoidWhen: Long sentences: every letter carries a stack of layers.
A flat, quiet title card: use per-character-rise.
author: Kokonut UI

variables.label: Font size
variables.description: Maximum text size in pixels. Longer text shrinks to fit the frame.

variables.label: Face color
variables.description: Color of the front of the letters.

variables.label: Near color
variables.description: Extrusion color right behind the face.

variables.label: Far color
variables.description: Extrusion color at its deepest layer.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Optional color for the deepest layer only (leave empty for none).

variables.label: Layers
variables.description: Stacked layers behind each letter (6 to 16).
